_comment: HOBL automation v2 schedule. Each job points at a HOBL testplan .ps1 file (the same file lab developers run locally with hobl.cmd). daily_run.ps1 parses that testplan and POSTs it to HOBLweb's /plan/Create as a brand-new plan with AutoResubmit set so it cycles 'runsPerDay' times. There is no template plan in HOBLweb's DB — the .ps1 in git is the source of truth.

monitor._comment: After submitting, daily_run.ps1 stays attached and polls HOBLweb every 'intervalSec' seconds, logging the current PlanID / cycle / scenario / status until the AutoResubmit chain finishes or 'maxHours' elapses. Set 'enabled' to false to revert to fire-and-forget.

email._comment: Weekly report email via send_report_email.ps1 (Outlook COM, logged-in account). 'to' is the recipient list (;-separated). Register the weekly task with: send_report_email.ps1 -Register -Day <day> -Time <HH:MM>.
